title: At Sergei's Side
summary: Strahd is destroyed, and Ireena keeps the promise she made at the Pool of the White Sun.

epilogue.title: Ireena Kolyana
epilogue.text: Ireena is gone from the world, and not lost. Pilgrims say the Pool of the White Sun stays warm now, even in the deepest winter.

epilogue.title: Ismark
epilogue.text: Once a year Ismark climbs to Krezk and sits by the pool for an hour without a word. Then he goes home and rules his village well.
